title: Virtual Reality Portals
shortDescription: A walk-in gateway to immersive virtual worlds where users explore, interact, and experience stories beyond physical space. Ideal for events, exhibitions, and brand moments that aim to truly wow.
longDescription: Users physically step into a portal that transports them into a fully interactive virtual environment. Whether for storytelling, training, education, or pure entertainment, this experience blends real movement with rich virtual worlds. Designed for intuitive use and high emotional impact, it turns curiosity into presence and moments into lasting memories.

highlights.title: Step Through, Not Just Look In
highlights.description: Visitors physically walk into the portal rather than watching from outside, so crossing the threshold becomes the moment itself and the experience reads as a place they entered, not a screen they looked at.

highlights.title: Real Movement, Virtual World
highlights.description: Their own steps and gestures drive what happens, blending physical motion with a rich virtual environment so the sense of actually being somewhere else holds up.

highlights.title: Intuitive From the First Second
highlights.description: Built so anyone can use it without a briefing, which matters when there is a queue outside and only a minute to get each guest in, oriented, and enjoying it.

highlights.title: Ways to Deepen the Trip
highlights.description: Add multi-person portals so people enter together, switch between a guided narrative and free roaming, layer in haptics, wind, or scent, set a timed mission, and tune the length of each session to the dwell time you need.

highlights.title: Worlds Worth Entering
highlights.description: Step inside a product or a factory line, travel to a historic site or a habitat under threat, run a safety or skills training scenario, or walk straight into a brand's own fantasy world, all through the same portal reskinned.

highlights.title: Proof of the Wow
highlights.description: Add an optional data layer that logs sessions run, dwell time, completion, the paths people chose inside the world, and opt-ins, then export it for a post-event report that puts numbers behind the reactions.

highlights.title: Bring the Queue Into It
highlights.description: Mirror the headset view onto a big screen with Live Feed so the waiting crowd watches along, tie each session to a guest with Visitor Identificator, hand them a shot from Connected Photographer, and let Journey Recap send the world they visited afterwards.
